validation.notes: Repaired migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the cwd encoder now replaces every backslash as well as slash and colon (replace(/[/\\:]/g, '-')) while still stripping exactly one leading slash/backslash, matching the session-manager encoding. The regression loads the real TypeScript migration module via .prale-eval/subject.mjs loadMigrations with a caller-owned temporary agentDir and real fs/path. It asserts POSIX, drive-letter (backslash and forward-slash) and UNC cwd encodings land in the exact --encoded-- directory; session bytes are preserved verbatim; malformed/non-session headers are ignored and left in place with no sessions dir created; an existing destination is never overwritten (destination and source bytes unchanged); repeated runs are idempotent and leave no extra directories or root-level jsonl files; and a mixed batch creates one directory per distinct cwd. Command exits 0 on the fixed code. Reverting only the encoder to the original replace(/[/:]/g, '-') makes the script fail with an AssertionError on the drive-letter case (observed dir '--C-\\Users\\dev\\my-project--' vs expected '--C--Users-dev-my-project--'), confirming the regression detects the original fault. No optional validation dependencies were unavailable; only Node 24 built-ins (node:assert, node:fs, node:path, node:os) are used and no network access is required.
